rows.text: Hey, why'd you come back to the restoration room?
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Are you... looking to have a chat with me?
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Hah hah, that's rare, someone wanting to chat with me, an artifact restorer! What would you like to talk about? I'm down for anything!
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Well, it's a museum, so naturally, it puts up all kinds of relics and artifacts on display.
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: This museum in particular doesn't have much in its collection, and you know the reason for it — the Eternal Freeze, the Fragmentum... They took so much from us.
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: However, we still collected everything we can and restored them so that we can put them on display. Because of that, the museum is at least somewhat decent.
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Anyway... please understand — if you feel dissatisfied during the tour — this is the best that we can do.
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: As an artifact restorer, my job is naturally to restore various cultural and historical pieces. Most of the artifacts and scale models that you can see in the exhibition hall were basically restored by me.
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Speaking of which, I was once an outstanding graduate from the Belobog College of Arts back then, specializing in sculptures. Uldan hired me to help create models, and I ended up having a job here as a restorer...
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: *sigh* There are still too few professionals in Belobog.
rows.speaker: Boris
